priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Do not write issued tokens to the audit log
findings.body: Every call with a bearer, session, or API token writes the raw credential to stdout, where production log collectors and operators can access and reuse it.

findings.title: [P2] Validate return URLs before redirecting
findings.body: location.assign accepts absolute and scheme-relative URLs, so this function now permits navigation to an arbitrary external origin when given an attacker-controlled returnUrl. Post-login links can consequently be used for trusted-domain phishing; restrict destinations to validated same-origin paths.
